scope: Single-step reference-state resets and continuous GPU state, isolated arithmetic candidates and unchanged-package controls; not release acceptance

rawEvidence.limitation: Raw captured tensors retained locally, not included in the published receipt

findings: Reference-state resets reduce accumulated state error; output error is not solely inherited through recurrence.
Readout-only compensation improves aggregate independent output accuracy on both physical GPUs without modifying state, but fails the unchanged full-model gate in both directions.
Memory-only compensation reduces aggregate state RMS error but fails both full-model directions; it is not an accepted correction.
Reference-rounded decay alone does not improve aggregate output accuracy; no decay helper was promoted.

Original split.13 matches the frozen reference exactly in the same-Mac control; the unchanged installed 0.6.4 candidate fails 16/55. Trace the package-dependent first divergence before another arithmetic substitution.
limitations: Captured independent recurrent controls cover 19 prefill tokens at layer zero, not arbitrary model continuations.
Full-model controls execute real browser partitions with diagnostic tensor forwarding and local verified bytes; they are not ordinary-page peer-acquisition acceptance.
Memory acceptance remains retained evidence for the earlier candidate and must be rerun after a numerical correction earns promotion.
Lower isolated operation error does not establish a passing or independently more accurate complete model.
